name: keeper
prompt:
Use case: illustration-story. Original Oathroll game art, Ledger & Lamplight. Painterly cinematic dark fantasy, rich oil-paint surfaces and bold deliberate brush masses, strong value contrast, readable silhouettes, restrained texture without film grain or tiny noise. Ink #14110F, Soot #221C18, Vellum #EDE3CF, faded ink #8A7F70, vermilion wax #B8322A, gilt #C9A24A, verdigris #3E8E7E; cold sea-blue darkness against one warm candlelight source. Eerie, melancholy, wondrous, never gory. Entirely original designs. Absolutely no text, letters, numbers, writing, typographic runes, logos or watermarks; any ledger pages are completely blank and wax seals bear only a plain abstract circle.
Asset type: character portrait, portrait 4:5 highest available resolution ideally 2048x2560. The Keeper, a hooded faceless scribe seated at a candlelit notary desk inside a drowned stone tower. Waist-up three-quarter portrait. Heavy soot-black hood, face completely hidden in unbroken shadow with no eyes, skin or features. Ordinary human-shaped hands, one holding a plain quill paused above an absolutely blank open vellum ledger, the other pressing a brass seal stamp into rich vermilion wax on blank folded paper, no glyph or lettering anywhere. One candle on left of desk is the sole warm light source, lights sleeve folds and hands, gilt brass and wax. Tall narrow stone window behind right reveals cold moonlit sea, subtle verdigris reflections. Quiet authority, impossible to bribe, careful ritual, eerie rather than evil. Focal hands, wax seal and hood; keep generous space above hood and full desk action within frame.
